# Security verdict: #269, round 1

Head: 9ec68d399c7cba523beece047c0c9c0152598dc5
Result: pass-with-notes. No introduced security vulnerabilities found.

|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No introduced vulnerabilities found | - |

## Registration boundary

HTTP registration substitutes the daemon-resolved harness process (crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:1156-1175), so the new reverse ancestry check catches the reported CLI-under-launcher shape (crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:747-786). Exact process equality remains covered by the existing collision/admission guard rather than this added refusal (registration.rs:1191-1210). No introduced ordinary-path bypass through choosing the process claim was identified.

This remains a directional brake: removing it admits the same or more registrations; it does not authorize retirement or rebinding. Own-id/supersedes and same-conversation exemptions precede the added check, including F213 restart continuity (registration.rs:762-809). Deliberate same-user session/identity impersonation remains the existing C33 limitation, not new authority introduced by this change. Unreadable ancestry or descent beyond the 64-hop budget can evade this conservative check; it is not per-seat authentication.

## Counter bounds and privacy

PaneHeld.holder and PaneHolderChild.holder originate from registry seat rows, and these refusals now tally the holder with known=true (registration.rs:289-320,783-785,2020-2023). by_key contains only enum-derived path/mode/outcome strings; candidate identifiers cannot enter its keys, and unknown client paths map to other. The generic by_seat fallback remains bounded: empty maps to (unnamed), unknown/untracked, overlong, or capacity-exceeding names map to (other); already-tracked names can retain their existing bucket (crates/daemon/src/registration/attempts.rs:19-27,96-105,236-281).

No identified added credentials, private transcripts, private repository identities/content, or machine-specific paths. Governance C21 and C32/C33/C34 were checked at community/RULINGS.md:25,36-38 after resolving the standing government root.

## Cost and proof notes

Zero added process launches and no periodic work. The addition performs at most 64 in-process parent reads per examined non-exempt local same-pane row per registration. Including the existing forward walk, the combined ceiling is 128 reads per row, not 64 (registration.rs:72-73,753-780,800-809). No live cost measurements were made.

The new fixture exercises ordinary service registration plus the brake, with refusal, unchanged holder, absent candidate, and counter assertions. It supplies the already-selected launcher identity through native_claim; it does not exercise HTTP/tmux claim resolution (registration.rs:2635-2637,2999-3053). This is a proof-scope note, not a demonstrated correctness or security defect. Captured harness insight INS-001: a resolver-to-brake composition fixture would better defend the loader/CLI boundary that the prior live proof exposed.

Local HEAD matched the full requested SHA and the worktree was clean. `just pr-freeze 269` returned FINAL. The live exact-head CI rollup showed check (22), check (24), rust-lint, rust-test in run 44497458612 and delivers in run 44497458394 all COMPLETED SUCCESS.

No local builds, tests, mutations, live registration probes, or dependency installation were performed. Test source was inspected; the packet's four-mutant kill claim was not independently inspected or reproduced. CI is the execution evidence.
